mapper.select: SELECT owner_id,task_id,kind,session_id,question_id,answer_id FROM ai_fact_draft_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT owner_id,task_id,excerpt_id,ordinal FROM ai_fact_draft_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT owner_id,task_id,status,target_project_id,target_item_id,target_version_id,created_at FROM ai_fact_draft_decision WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND task_id=#{taskId}

SELECT v.id,v.owner_id,v.item_id,i.kind,i.project_id,p.kind AS project_kind,v.version_number AS number FROM preparation_version v JOIN preparation_item i ON i.owner_id=v.owner_id AND i.id=v.item_id LEFT JOIN preparation_item p ON p.owner_id=i.owner_id AND p.id=i.project_id WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.item_id=#{itemId} AND v.id=#{versionId}
SELECT excerpt_id FROM preparation_material_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND item_id=#{itemId} AND version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY excerpt_id
